summary: Comprehensive testing of AI-powered lead-generation chatbot widget. All backend APIs (POST /api/chatbot/message, POST /api/chatbot/lead, GET /api/chatbot/leads, GET /api/chatbot/leads/stats) working correctly. Frontend chatbot widget renders on marketing pages only, with full interaction flow (role selection, interest selection, chat mode) working. LeadsDashboard at /leads displays leads with search and filter functionality. Lead scoring correctly assigns high priority to district/admin roles and medium to teachers.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatbotWidget.jsx: Well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
chatbot.py: Lead scoring logic correctly identifies high priority roles (district, administrator, admin, principal) and interests (demo, enterprise, school solution)
LeadsDashboard.js: Proper use of withCredentials for authenticated API calls
App.js: MARKETING_PATHS array correctly controls chatbot visibility on marketing pages only
Resend email notification is in test mode - NOTIFICATION_EMAIL not configured, so high-priority lead emails are logged but not sent (MOCKED)
seed_data_creation: Created test leads with TEST_ prefix during backend testing (TEST_Jane, TEST_Robert, TEST_Principal, TEST_Minimal, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chatbot lead generation feature fully tested. 13 leads in DB (10 high, 3 medium). Test leads have TEST_ prefix. LeadsDashboard accessible at /leads for authenticated users. Chatbot appears on MARKETING_PATHS: /, /auth, /features, /pricing, /contact, /trust, /homeschool, /ai-features, /integrations, /enterprise-overview, /help, and paths starting with /features/ or /use-cases/.

Chatbot NOT on /dashboard.details: Chatbot bubble correctly NOT shown on authenticated dashboard page

Chatbot opens with role selection.details: Clicking bubble opens chat window with role options (Teacher, Tutor, Homeschool Educator, School Administrator, District/Enterprise, Other)

Role selection sends message to API.details: POST /api/chatbot/message called with visitor_role context, AI response received

Interest options appear after role.details: Interest options (Lesson Planning, Grading & Gradebook, AI Tools, etc.) appear after role selection

Interest selection starts chat mode.details: Chat input field appears after selecting interest

User can send messages in chat.details: Messages sent via data-testid='chatbot-send', AI responses received

Lead capture prompt after 3 exchanges.details: Code shows lead prompt appears when messageCount >= 2 (after 3rd message)

Lead form submission.details: POST /api/chatbot/lead stores lead in MongoDB with correct scoring

Lead scoring - teacher = medium.details: Teacher role leads scored as 'medium' priority

Lead scoring - district/admin = high.details: District, administrator, admin, principal roles scored as 'high' priority

GET /api/chatbot/leads requires auth.details: Returns 401 without auth cookie, 200 with auth

GET /api/chatbot/leads/stats requires au.details: Returns 401 without auth cookie, 200 with stats (total, high_priority, medium_priority, low_priority, new_leads)

LeadsDashboard loads at /leads.details: Stats cards (Total Leads, High Priority, Medium Priority, New/Unread) and lead list displayed

LeadsDashboard search filter.details: Search by name/email/organization filters leads correctly

ScrollToTop component.details: Page scrolls to top when navigating between routes

mocked_apis.Resend email notification: MOCKED - NOTIFICATION_EMAIL not configured, high-priority lead emails logged but not sent
